display_long_description:
**Evil Inside VR** reimagines the original psychological horror game exclusively for virtual reality. After losing his mother and seeing his father arrested for her death, Mark uses a Spirit Board hoping to contact her one last time. Instead, he unleashes something terrifying inside his home.
[media]

As Mark, you must recover the broken pieces of the board while exploring a house where reality constantly shifts around you. Flickering lights, distorted spaces, and disturbing apparitions turn every moment into a fight against fear itself.

[media]

Designed specifically for VR, the game features immersive interactions, redesigned gameplay elements, and an oppressive atmosphere that surrounds you from beginning to end. Discover the truth behind the family tragedy before the darkness consumes everything.
